notes: Next.js careers page (RSC-embedded postings) with a client-side search: input#keyword[name=keyword][type=search] (Keyword) and input[name=selectedLocations][type=hidden] (Location). There is no <form> and the URL is not rewritten when filtering; the rendered page shows '12 open jobs found' with those fields blank. The scraper reads the unfiltered RSC rows and filters locally. Plain curl gets a Vercel security checkpoint, so collection needs a browser-like client.
evidence: https://www.gojek.io/careers (rendered DOM: input#keyword[name=keyword] type=search, input[name=selectedLocations] type=hidden, '12 open jobs found', no form element)
